## {.rebuild}

<div class="cover-title">图像<span class="accent">编码</span></div>
<div class="cover-subtitle">从真实照片，到像素、颜色与二进制</div>

::: {.notes}
本页承接上一课字符编码。开场时不用急着讲采样、量化、编码，只说明今天换一种数据：图像。核心问题是：我们眼睛看到的真实画面，计算机究竟怎样保存？
:::

---

## 拍下一朵花，计算机保存了什么？ {.rebuild}

::: {.two-col wide-right}
<div>
<div class="big-question">手机拍下的是<span class="accent">一朵花</span>，还是一堆数据？</div>
<div class="thesis">先从一个人人都有经验的动作开始：拍照。</div>
<ul class="small-list">
<li>我们看到的是花。</li>
<li>手机保存的是图片文件。</li>
<li>计算机内部最终只能处理数字。</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div>
<div class="phone">
<img src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/39/Sunflower_Helianthus_1_edited.png" alt="向日葵照片">
</div>
<div class="caption">同一张花朵图将贯穿前半节课</div>
</div>
:::

<div class="source-note">Image source: Wikimedia Commons, “Sunflower Helianthus 1 edited.png”.</div>

::: {.notes}
这里复刻原课的生活情境：先让学生进入“拍照”的熟悉经验。可以问：你觉得手机保存照片时，是把一朵花真的装进去了，还是保存了一些数字？这只是引入，不展开文件格式。
:::

---

## 照片放大后，为什么会糊？ {.rebuild}

<div class="center-box">
  <div>
    <div class="big-question">照片不断放大，为什么最后会看到<span class="accent">一个个小方块</span>？</div>
    <div class="thesis">先预测，再观察：这些小方块是从哪里来的？</div>
  </div>
</div>

::: {.notes}
对应原课问题页。让学生先预测：放大会变清晰、变模糊，还是看到更多细节？学生通常会提到“像素”。暂时只记录，不急着定义。
:::

---

## 先看一张真实照片 {.rebuild}

::: {.two-col wide-left}
<div>
<img class="photo" src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/39/Sunflower_Helianthus_1_edited.png" alt="向日葵照片">
<div class="caption">真实照片：颜色连续、细节丰富</div>
</div>

<div class="callout">
我们看到的是一幅完整的图像。<br><br>
但计算机不能直接保存“花”这个整体，它必须把图像拆成可以表示的数据。
</div>
:::

<div class="source-note">Image source: Wikimedia Commons, “Sunflower Helianthus 1 edited.png”.</div>

::: {.notes}
对应原课展示原图。讲述时可以先让学生只观察：花瓣、花盘、背景、颜色变化。下一页再展示放大后的像素化结果。
:::

## 放大到最后，看见了什么？ {.rebuild}

::: {.two-col}
<div>
<img class="photo" src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/39/Sunflower_Helianthus_1_edited.png" alt="向日葵照片局部">
<div class="caption">从远处看：仍然像完整照片</div>
</div>

<div>
<div class="pixel-grid zoom">
<span class="c2"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span>
<span class="c2"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c3"></span>
<span class="c2"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span>
<span class="c4"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c4"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>

这里不用真实截图，而用一个清晰的像素格示意替代原课放大截图。追问：这些格子是不是现实花朵本身就有的？学生会意识到：这和计算机表示图像的方法有关。
:::

## 思维实验：怎样把一朵花放进计算机？ {.rebuild}

<div class="big-question">如果计算机只能保存数字，怎样表示这朵花？</div>

<div class="process">
<div class="step"><h3>1. 采样</h3><p>在哪些位置取信息？</p></div>
<div class="step"><h3>2. 量化</h3><p>每个位置用哪些有限值描述？</p></div>
<div class="step"><h3>3. 编码</h3><p>这些值怎样变成 0 和 1？</p></div>
<div class="step"><h3>4. 存储</h3><p>二进制数据按规则组成图像文件。</p></div>
</div>

<div class="thesis">接下来只用一台“很差的相机”做思想实验。</div>

::: {.notes}
对应原课“思维实验：图像编码的过程”。这页是过渡页。不要把定义讲死，只预告接下来要一步步做。
:::

---

## 相机只能采 3×4 个位置，会怎样？ {.rebuild}

::: {.two-col}
<div>
<div class="grid-overlay">
<img src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/39/Sunflower_Helianthus_1_edited.png" alt="向日葵照片覆盖 3×4 网格">
<div class="overlay">
<span></span><span></span><span></span>
<span></span><span></span><span></span>
<span></span><span></span><span></span>
<span></span><span></span><span></span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="caption">横向 3 个位置，纵向 4 个位置</div>
</div>

<div>
<div class="callout">
这台相机只有 <span class="accent">3×4</span> 个采样位置。<br><br>
它最多只能记录 <span class="accent">12</span> 个位置的信息。
</div>
<div class="math-line">分辨率：3 × 4</div>
</div>
:::

::: {.notes}
复刻原课 3×4 光敏元件模型。问：一共有多少个采样点？学生回答 12。强调此处写成 3×4，而不是只写 12，因为横向和纵向位置关系也很重要。
:::

---

## 第一步：采样 {.rebuild}

::: {.two-col}
<div>
<h3>从连续图像中取有限位置</h3>
<div class="pixel-grid g3x4">
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c3"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c3"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
</div>
<div class="caption">3×4：只保留 12 个位置的代表颜色</div>
</div>

<div>
<div class="callout">
<span class="accent">采样</span>：从原来的连续图像中，选取有限数量的位置。<br><br>
采样位置越少，图像越粗糙。
</div>
</div>
:::

::: {.notes}
对应原课 step1。这里先让学生看到 3×4 的粗糙像素花，再给动作命名为“采样”。可以提醒：这不是现实花朵变成了格子，而是我们记录图像时只记录了有限位置。
:::

---

## 第二步：量化 {.rebuild}

::: {.two-col wide-left}
<div>
<table class="map-table">
<thead><tr><th>颜色</th><th>编号</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td><span class="color-chip c0"></span>白色</td><td>0</td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="color-chip c1"></span>红色</td><td>1</td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="color-chip c2"></span>黄色</td><td>2</td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="color-chip c3"></span>绿色</td><td>3</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>

<div>
<div class="pixel-grid g3x4">
<span class="c0">0</span><span class="c2">2</span><span class="c0">0</span>
<span class="c1">1</span><span class="c1">1</span><span class="c3">3</span>
<span class="c0">0</span><span class="c2">2</span><span class="c3">3</span>
<span class="c0">0</span><span class="c3">3</span><span class="c0">0</span>
</div>
<div class="caption">颜色变成有限的整数值</div>
</div>
:::

::: {.notes}
对应原课颜色编号。用有限整数值描述样本，这一步叫量化。强调“颜色”被限制在四种选择中：白、红、黄、绿。
:::

---

## 第三步：编码 {.rebuild}

::: {.two-col wide-left}
<div>
<table class="map-table">
<thead><tr><th>颜色</th><th>数值</th><th>二进制编码</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td><span class="color-chip c0"></span>白色</td><td>0</td><td><div class="bit-row"><span class="bit">0</span><span class="bit">0</span></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="color-chip c1"></span>红色</td><td>1</td><td><div class="bit-row"><span class="bit">0</span><span class="bit">1</span></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="color-chip c2"></span>黄色</td><td>2</td><td><div class="bit-row"><span class="bit">1</span><span class="bit">0</span></div></td></tr>
<tr><td><span class="color-chip c3"></span>绿色</td><td>3</td><td><div class="bit-row"><span class="bit">1</span><span class="bit">1</span></div></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>

<div>
<div class="big-question">四种颜色，为什么只需要 <span class="accent">2 bit</span>？</div>
<div class="thesis">2 bit 可以表示 4 种状态：00、01、10、11。</div>
</div>
:::

::: {.notes}
复刻原课中的真实困难：有学生会把 12 个采样点和 4 种颜色状态混淆。这里要追问：现在编码的是“几个格子”，还是“几种颜色”？最后形成位深度概念：描述一个像素颜色所用的 bit 数。
:::

---

## 怎样让它更像原图？ {.rebuild}

<div class="compare-grid">
<div class="compare-item">
<h3>3×4，4 色</h3>
<div class="pixel-grid g3x4">
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c3"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c3"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
</div>
<div class="caption">粗糙：采样点少</div>
</div>

<div class="compare-item">
<h3>6×8，4 色</h3>
<div class="pixel-grid g6x8">
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>
</div>
<div class="caption">提高分辨率：形状更细</div>
</div>

<div class="compare-item">
<h3>6×8，6 色</h3>
<div class="pixel-grid g6x8">
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c1"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c5"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c1"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c5"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c1"></span><span class="c4"></span><span class="c5"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c2"></span><span class="c5"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c5"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>
<span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c3"></span><span class="c0"></span><span class="c0"></span>
</div>
<div class="caption">增加颜色数：色彩更丰富</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="thesis">提高分辨率改变“取多少位置”；提高位深度改变“每个位置能表示多少颜色”。</div>

::: {.notes}
对应原课第 11 张截图。先让学生判断哪一张更接近原图，再分别追问原因。第二列只提高分辨率，颜色数不变；第三列保持分辨率，增加颜色数，由此引出位深度增加。
:::
